promises.statement: Cut prescription drug costs, repeal gas taxes, get housing costs under control.
A $35 monthly cap on insulin; bring more doctors to the Valley.
Treat homelessness as an emergency: mental health, addiction services, job training.

votes.title: Laken Riley Act
votes.what_it_does: Requires the Department of Homeland Security to detain certain non-U.S. nationals arrested for burglary, theft, larceny, shoplifting, assault of a law enforcement officer, or any crime resulting in death or serious bodily injury, and authorizes states to sue over certain federal immigration decisions.

votes.title: Protecting American Energy Production Act
votes.what_it_does: Prohibits the President from declaring a moratorium on the use of hydraulic fracturing unless Congress authorizes the moratorium.

votes.title: SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act of 2025
votes.what_it_does: Reauthorizes and revises federal programs and activities addressing substance use disorders, overdoses, and mental health.

votes.title: Jeremy and Angel Seay and Sergeant Brandon Mendoza Protect Our Communities from DUIs Act
votes.what_it_does: Makes driving while intoxicated or impaired a ground for barring a non-U.S. national from admission to the United States or for deporting the individual.

votes.title: One Big Beautiful Bill Act
votes.what_it_does: Reduces taxes, reduces or increases spending for various federal programs, increases the statutory debt limit, and otherwise addresses agencies and programs throughout the federal government.
votes.outcome: Passed 218-214 (motion to concur in Senate amendment; final House passage)

votes.title: Continuing Appropriations, Agriculture, Legislative Branch, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Extensions Act, 2026
votes.what_it_does: Ends the government shutdown that began October 1, 2025 by providing FY2026 continuing appropriations for most federal agencies through January 30, 2026, plus full-year appropriations for agriculture, military construction and veterans affairs, and legislative branch programs.
votes.outcome: Passed 222-209 (motion to concur in Senate amendment)

votes.title: Housing for the 21st Century Act
votes.what_it_does: Establishes and modifies various federal housing programs with the stated purpose of increasing the supply of housing in America.

votes.title: Military Construction, Veterans Affairs, and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 2027
votes.what_it_does: Provides FY2027 appropriations for military construction, the Department of Veterans Affairs, and related agencies.

promises.statement: Protected 1,000+ local manufacturing jobs; ended forced high-cost internet contracts for renters.
$10 million for Family Justice Centers; tougher penalties for trafficking and drunk driving.
Improved wildfire response; $20 million to protect the Delta from invasive species.

votes.title: Crimes: prostitution
votes.what_it_does: Expands penalties for soliciting or purchasing commercial sex when the person solicited is a minor, particularly when the minor is significantly younger than the defendant or is a human trafficking victim.

votes.title: Budget Act of 2025
votes.what_it_does: Makes appropriations for the support of state government for the 2025-26 fiscal year.

votes.title: Housing
votes.what_it_does: Exempts qualifying infill housing development projects from the California Environmental Quality Act and makes permanent several expiring streamlining provisions for compliant housing projects.
votes.outcome: Passed 62-3 (concurrence in Senate amendments; budget trailer bill)

votes.title: Congressional redistricting (Election Rigging Response Act)
votes.what_it_does: Proposes a state constitutional amendment requiring California to use the congressional districts in AB 604 for every congressional election until the citizens commission draws new lines in 2031, subject to voter approval.

votes.title: Landlord-tenant: internet service provider subscriptions
votes.what_it_does: Beginning January 1, 2026, requires landlords to let tenants opt out of paying for a third-party internet service subscription tied to the rental, and lets tenants deduct the subscription cost from rent if the landlord violates the opt-out.
votes.outcome: Passed 64-10 (concurrence in Senate amendments; Ransom is the author)

votes.title: Housing development: transit-oriented development
votes.what_it_does: Makes qualifying housing projects near major transit stops an allowed use in residential and commercial zones when they meet specified unit-count, density, and height requirements.

votes.title: Climate change: market-based compliance mechanism: extension
votes.what_it_does: Extends California's market-based greenhouse gas compliance program (Cap-and-Invest) through December 31, 2045, with new offset credit limits and a Climate Mitigation Fund for revenue from allowance sales at the price ceiling.

votes.title: Oil spill prevention: gasoline specifications: suspension: California Environmental Quality Act: exemptions: County of Kern: transportation fuels assessment: coastal resources
votes.what_it_does: Authorizes suspension of certain California gasoline specifications, creates CEQA exemptions for oil and gas activities in Kern County, and requires a state transportation fuels assessment.
